threeDSToken.description: Contains a token generated during the 3DS authentication process.

browserInfo.description: Holds information related to the user's web browser.

clientIP.description: Stores the IP address of the client or user making the request.

id.description: Identifier of an order for which the payment should be authorized.

paymentModeId.description: Identifier of a payment mode configured in the payment-gateway service for a given tenant.

creditCardToken.description: Indicates a payment method token, usually generated on a frontend site, when an user provides a credit card information.
